'''Yash Birla Group''' is Indian industrial [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] group based in [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.yashbirlagroup.com/index.php/main/index/Contact_Us_1 |title=The Yash Birla Group |publisher=The Yash Birla Group |date=29 January 2009 |access-date=9 January 2011 |archive-date=1 January 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110101172744/http://www.yashbirlagroup.com/index.php/main/index/Contact_Us_1 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Its chairman Yashovardhan Birla, is a member of the [[Birla family]]. The group has diversified interest in industries like steel pipes, [[machine tools]], cutting tools, tool holders, iron castings, power solution{{buzzword inline|date=September 2019}} products, multipurpose engines pumps, electrical appliances, textiles, carpets, furnishing, lifestyle, infotech, publication, travel, electricity, property development, cotton ginning etc.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2013-01-11/news/36279981_1_birla-power-solutions-pvr-murthy-defaults|title=Lenders file suits against Birla Power for payment defaults|access-date=27 July 2013|archive-date=3 August 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130803114612/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2013-01-11/news/36279981_1_birla-power-solutions-pvr-murthy-defaults|url-status=dead}}</ref>
The Group traces its origins to the businesses started by various members of the [[Birla family]].
The group today has 10 publicly listed subsidiaries in India.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bseindia.com/scripsearch/scrips.aspx?myScrip=birla&Submit=GO&selScrip=0&flag=sr&navigate=S |title=BSE - Scrip Search |website=www.bseindia.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081025061653/http://www.bseindia.com/scripsearch/scrips.aspx?myScrip=birla&Submit=GO&selScrip=0&flag=sr&navigate=S |archive-date=2008-10-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.moneylife.in/article/yash-birla-group-companies-in-deep-trouble/33259.html|title=Yash Birla Group companies in deep trouble?|website=Moneylife NEWS & VIEWS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.moneylife.in/article/how-to-get-your-money-back-from-yash-birla-group-companies/34593/44514.html|title=How to get your money back from Yash Birla group companies|website=Moneylife NEWS & VIEWS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.complaintboard.in/complaints-reviews/zenith-birla-l253496.html |title=zenith birla Complaints<!-- Bot generated title --> |access-date=26 June 2013 |archive-date=1 July 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130701085837/http://www.complaintboard.in/complaints-reviews/zenith-birla-l253496.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=autogenerated2 />
The group is currently facing major financial and legal bottlenecks.<ref name=autogenerated2>{{Cite web|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2013-06-01/news/39674913_1_birla-power-pvr-murthy-birla-pacific-medspa|title=Yashovardhan Birla resigns from boards of four listed group companies|access-date=26 June 2013|archive-date=1 July 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130701085839/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2013-06-01/news/39674913_1_birla-power-pvr-murthy-birla-pacific-medspa|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name=autogenerated1 /><ref name=autogenerated3 /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/yash-birla-firm-faces-rs-1-000-cr-loan-recall-113041500377_1.html|title=Yash Birla firm faces Rs 1,000-cr loan recall|first=Manojit|last=Saha}}</ref>

In June 2013, the group was declared a [[Non Performing Assets (NPA)|Non Performing Asset (NPA)]] account for non payment of dues. Further in 2016, [[UCO Bank]] also published a notice indicating Birla as defaulter. On 16 June 2019, he was declared wilful defaulter by the bank with outstanding dues of over 67 crores.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://qz.com/india/1645664/the-fall-of-yash-birla-declared-wilful-defaulter-by-uco-bank/|title=A flamboyant Indian industrialist is now chased by a bank his ancestor founded|last=Tanwar|first=Sangeeta|website=Quartz India|date=17 June 2019 |language=en|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref>`

==Subsidiaries==
'''Zenith Birla (India) Ltd:''' Zenith Birla (India) Limited was incorporated in 1960, and commenced its commercial production in 1962. ZBIL, a flagship company of Yash Birla Group, is a pioneer in Manufacture and Exports of Steel Pipes, Tubes, and Hollow Sections from India. The Company's plants are located at Khopoli, Tarapur & Murbad. The Khopoli Plant has a complete Manufacturing and Residential complex for its employees with facilities of School, Club House, Guest House, Temple and Auditorium.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.yashbirlagroup.com/ |title=Home |website=yashbirlagroup.com |access-date=2 July 2008 |archive-date=18 May 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080518060029/http://www.yashbirlagroup.com/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-industry/cons-products/electronics/Yash-Birla-Group-set-to-re-establish-appliances-biz/articleshow/6033033.cms|title=Yash Birla Group set to re-establish appliances biz|date=10 June 2010|via=The Economic Times - The Times of India}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.hindu.com/2010/02/04/stories/2010020458380200.htm|title=The Hindu : Andhra Pradesh / Hyderabad News : Yash Birla group forays into education|website=www.hindu.com|access-date=9 January 2011|archive-date=17 September 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100917002812/http://www.hindu.com/2010/02/04/stories/2010020458380200.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>

'''Birla Precision Technologies Limited''' is an Indian engineering company.<ref name="Birla Precision 2">{{cite news |title=Birla Precision Technologies Management Information - Details of Birla Precision Technologies Management - The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/birla-precision-technologies-ltd/infocompanymanagement/companyid-13953.cms |accessdate=7 November 2020 |work=[[The Economic Times]]}}</ref> It was established in 1937,<ref>{{cite news |title=Birla Precision Technologies Ltd Stock Price - (), Birla Precision Technologies Ltd Share Price Live Today, Birla Precision Technologies LtdStock Live BSE/NSE Share Price |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/stock-market/birla-precision-technologies-ltd-stock-price/ |accessdate=7 November 2020 |work=[[The Financial Express (India)|Financial Express]]}}</ref> and is a part of the group. 

Birla Precision Tech has 5 divisions, spread over 4 factories. It is mainly in the auto component and industrial engineering domain.<ref>{{cite news |title=Birla Precision Share Price, Birla Precision Stock Price, Birla Precision Technologies Ltd. Stock Price, Share Price, Live BSE/NSE, Birla Precision Technologies Ltd. Bids Offers. Buy/Sell Birla Precision Technologies Ltd. news & tips, & F&O Quotes, NSE/BSE Forecast News and Live Quotes |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/india/stockpricequote/machine-tools/birlaprecisiontechnologies/BPT01 |accessdate=7 November 2020 |work=[[Moneycontrol.com]] |language=en}}</ref> The company exports to more than 25 countries. It is listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] Stock Exchange. The chairman & managing director of the company is Vedant Birla.

Earlier JVs made in the group include Birla Yamaha, Birla 3M, Birla Kennametal, Birla Perucchini, Birla Delonghi, Dagger Forst, South Pacific Viscose, etc. Major customers of the companies include [[Cummins]], [[Honeywell]], government engineering companies, defence, and aerospace.<ref name="Birla 2">{{cite web |last1=Ltd |first1=Birla Precision Technologies |title=About Birla Precision Technologies Ltd {{!}} Cutting Tools And Tool Holder Manufacturers {{!}} India |url=https://www.birlaprecision.com/about-us.php |website=www.birlaprecision.com |accessdate=8 November 2020 |language=en}}</ref>
